## Change

Describe the behavior change and why it is needed.

## Evidence

Record the exact commands/results, OS and browser/FFmpeg used. Distinguish mocks from end-to-end tests and list checks not run.

## Review

- [ ] Added a regression for the reproduced bug or new behavior.
- [ ] Kept No processing / Lossless RGB exact-reference behavior intact.
- [ ] Verified queue/thread ownership and cancellation when affected.
- [ ] Did not introduce a fallback duration or silent source/codec substitution.
- [ ] Updated README/reference/known limits when behavior changed.
- [ ] No credentials, personal inputs, generated videos, fonts or runtime binaries are included.
